chunks: At the ₹34 cap, the price is 21.66x reported FY26 diluted earnings of ₹1.57 a share.
Listed peers range from OnEMI at 16.62x, SBI Cards 27.98x and Bajaj Finance 33.66x, to PB Fintech at 120.33x.
Remember the reported figure already carries the one-time charge; on pre-exceptional profit the multiple would be lower.
